about: The Workbench icons of the AlephOne drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Aleph One's own program icon (flatpak/alephone.png) and its scenario file icon (data/icons/128x128/application-x-alephone-scea.png). AlephOne-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, AlephOne.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's AlephOne.info. Scenario.info, MML.info, Plugins.info, Default_Theme.info and resources.info are the subdrawers' (the Makefile puts each in its place).
